update_config_contract.rule: manifest_url must be HTTPS and its hostname must be included in trusted_hosts

rules: version must parse as numeric dot-separated components and be greater than 0.2.0 for N→N+1 acceptance
artifact_url must be HTTPS on a trusted host
artifact_sha256 must be the actual SHA-256 of the exact downloaded main EXE
artifact_bytes must equal the exact downloaded byte length and be <= 512 MiB

real_acceptance_sequence: Create dedicated Happy8 repository visible to the connected GitHub installation
Verify isolated seed tree identity against the frozen migration manifest
Run full frozen gates on dedicated repository exact commit
Publish real Release N containing exact main EXE, independent Updater EXE, and trusted HTTPS update config
Publish real newer Release N+1 and trusted manifest whose version is numerically greater than N
Launch Release N exact main EXE and physically click 一键更新

Updater fetches real HTTPS manifest and artifact, validates byte count and SHA-256, backs up N, waits for/ensures main closure, atomically replaces, launches/self-tests N+1, then commits or rolls back
Verify normal N→N+1 update evidence and negative paths: offline, interruption, bad hash, corruption, permission, occupied main, replace failure, health failure, rollback failure, restart recovery
Freeze N+1 final EXE after all release-affecting processing
Physically click 预测下一期 / 一键更新 / 一键修复 / 高级分析 on that exact final EXE
Recompute post-GUI SHA-256 and require exact Same Hash
Generate real_release_update.json, FINAL_ARTIFACT.json, engineering/business acceptance and Final Gate from the dedicated repository lineage
forbidden_substitutes: local test package presented as production release

missing: real trusted HTTPS release host/release URLs
real Release N and newer Release N+1
blocker.note: No URL, hostname, version, signature/hash, or release evidence is invented in this document.
